golden.note: outer option, inner list of maps; keys are emitted in unsigned UTF-8 byte order, not source order
Phase 3A has no producers, so the harness binds the slot
expression 1 is referenced twice: shared subexpressions are not copied
the decomposed key is NFC-normalized in the canonical bytes
Container is a nested list/map/option record; the selected field 2 is map<string,int64>, re-encoded as a canonical object

negative.note: MachineFloat is an alias of float64; the workflow universe is closed
Metrics.ratio is float64: binding it forces the machine-only primitive into the workflow layer
field 3 is Status, bound with a string
case 2 is unit, bound with a string
option_some of a string derives option<string>, not option<int64>
PrimitiveConstant is closed to the 9 workflow primitives, so a machine-only constant case is unrepresentable in the typed model: rejection happens when the document is parsed

note: Frozen semantic-core golden and negative cases. Golden cases carry a full SemanticCoreDocument (types/values/expressions/resources), one expression id and the canonical ACE1 bytes of its lowered value; expected bytes, derived types and negative error kinds were produced by the independent Python implementation (tools/gen-semantic-core-corpus.py) and must never be regenerated by the Rust implementation under test.
